facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter citing lack of efficacy evidence · Filed (NDA) · reproxalap in dry eye disease · filed for approval

evidence.summary: the application has failed to demonstrate efficacy in adequate and well controlled studies in the treatment of signs and symptoms of dry eye disease.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the “totality of evidence from the completed clinical trials does not support the effectiveness of the product.”
evidence.safety: Consistent with prior NDA reviews of reproxalap, no safety or manufacturing concerns were identified.
evidence.program_discontinued: intends to expeditiously request a Type A meeting to understand the actions needed for NDA approval.
